description: This file is a Perl script that creates a custom firmware image for a Broadcom-based device, specifically replacing or simulating the 'brcmImagebuilder'. It reads kernel and root filesystem images, processes headers, and packs them into a combined image file with specific metadata and layout requirements.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a scalar, used to load kernel and root filesystem images.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates the padding length needed to align data to a specified block size.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to align its length plus offset to a specified block size.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Creates a firmware image with a specific header, incorporating kernel and root filesystem data. Handles packing header info, CRC checks, and writing the final image.
